caseNameFull: ETSI Pipeline Project v. Missouri and Hodel, Secretary of the Interior v. Missouri

opinions.text: C. A. 8th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 480 U. S. 905.] Motion of the Solicitor General for divided argument denied. Motion of respondents for divided argument denied. Motion of Montana et al. for leave to participate in oral argument as amici curiae, for additional time for oral argument, and for divided argument denied.
